units.source_text: 千代子虽不是模特儿，但有一次她在他的画室里居然找不到自己的腰带了，

en.t: Although Chiyoko was not a model, once in his studio she somehow could not find her own sash,

units.source_text: 只好把他的布腰带缠在自己的绸单衣上，到大街上的菜店去买萝卜。

en.t: so she had no choice but to wrap his cloth sash around her own silk unlined kimono and go to the greengrocer on the main street to buy daikon.

units.source_text: 他想画那种姿态的千代子。

en.t: He wanted to paint Chiyoko in that pose.
